title: Ignorant Failure Recovery (Omission-Crash Conflation)
pattern: Immediately assuming a crash and taking destructive actions (like removing nodes or discarding local data) upon a simple network connection timeout or omission fault.
why_bad: It conflates an omission fault (a dropped packet or slow responder) with a crash failure. In-flight state and identity are destroyed. If the node was merely slow, re-adding it causes high resource consumption, churn, or split-brain.
detection: Error handlers catching network timeouts that trigger immediate state destruction or node removal.
